# Error Handler
The other four workflows are linked to this one (in each workflow: Settings, then Error workflow).

If one of them crashes, n8n runs this workflow automatically and sends me a Telegram message with:
- the workflow that failed
- the node that failed
- the error message
- a link to that run

This is the last safety net. Inside the workflows there are two more layers.

**Retry On Fail** (nodes with the circular-arrows icon): the node tries again before giving up.
- Supabase nodes that read, save or delete deadlines and settings, in all workflows (3 tries)
- Claude nodes in Extract & Save (2 or 3 tries)
- Telegram: download file in Main, and Telegram: alert me here (3 tries)

**Error outputs** (a second "Error" exit on the node): instead of crashing, the person gets a friendly message.
- Main: Run sub-workflow → Telegram: save failed
- Web API: Run sub-workflow → Respond: save failed
- Extract & Save: Claude: read PDF / read image → Set: couldn't read file
